question: Where’s the closest fast food restaurant you hit on the way to Susan Hambley Nature Center, Brunswick, OH from Mentor Civic Arena, Mentor, OH?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Mentor Civic Arena%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Mentor%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OH%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Susan Hambley Nature Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Brunswick%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OH%' LIMIT 1 ), route_segment AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry) AS geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ), buffered_route AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(geom::geography, 1000) AS geom -- Create a 1000-meter buffer around the straight-line segment FROM route_segment ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, buffered_route br, end_point ep WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, br.geom) -- Filter fast food restaurants within the buffered route ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, ep.geometry::geography) ASC -- Order by distance to the destination LIMIT 1;
